chapter: Union, publishers, race and Harlem nightlife
title: Midge Williams
summary: Midge Williams was a vocalist with Armstrong's band, petite and nice, who died young.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: She was the vocalist with Louis Armstrong's band.
I think she died very young.
Butch, I think they called her Butch. She used to call me Newly all the time.
I never will forget her, very cute, petite and cute. She died I think up in Detroit... She was so nice. In those days, you know, everybody was so nice.
